page.layout: One printed page, single column, centred dedication text. Ornamental printer's rule at the top. No margin notes. No page number, running head or catchword visible.

main_text.head: Magnificis, Amplissimis, Prudentissimis, Consultissimisq; Viris ac Dominis, Patriæ Patribus,
main_text.p: Dn. JOH. JACOBO BUCHERO, Illustrissimæ ac Potentissimæ Reipubl. Bernensis, quoad ditionem Germanicam, Quæstori Dignissimo, Gravissimo, ut legationibus plurimis summa cum laude peractis, ita imprimis nuperā ad Serenissimum Galliarum Regem Claro, Mecoenati & Fautori suo magno, Cognato, omnis obsequij humilimi genere ad aras Colendo.
Dn. ABRAHAMO HENNIO, ejusdem laudatæ Reipubl. Tribuno Dignissimo, Mecoenati, Patrono, Agnato & Benefactori nunquàm satis demerendo.
Dn. SAMUELI FISCHERO, itidem apud Bernates Senatori Prudentissimo, Fautori & Agnato Faventissimo, plurimùm Honorando.
main_text.head: Reverendis, Disertissimis, Celeberrimis Viris:
main_text.p: Dn. Pastoribus & Professoribus Ecclesiæ & Scholæ Patriæ, adeoq; toti Venerando coetui Ecclesiastico, & præsertim hujus non infimo membro;
Dn. NICOLAO MOLITORI, in eadem Ecclesia Pastori, & Eloquiorum Dei Dispensatori Fidelissimo, Gravissimo, Avunculo, Fautori & Euergetæ suo æternùm suspiciendo.
main_text.head: Reverendis, Consultissimis, Doctissimis Viris, Dominis:
main_text.p: Dn. SALOMONI REGI, Illust. Reipubl. Bernensis Medico ordinario & experientissimo,
Dn. SAMUELI BUNDELINO, Comitatûs Wangensis Præfecto Dignissimo.
Dn. DANIELI IM HOOFF, rarâ prudentiâ & defæcatâ eruditione Claro, Præfecto Grandissonensi Meritissimo.
Dn. BALTHASARO IM HOOFF, Ducentum-viro Spectatissimo, Integerrimo.
Dominis Avunculis, Cognatis, Fautoribus & Amicis ætatem honorandis.

p.i: In cultûs devotissimi testificationem, debiti amoris, gratiâ animi indicium hocce exercitium sacrum quàm officiosissimè D. D. C. O.

page.notes: The Latin dedication is set in roman and italic; the printed "Dn." abbreviations are italic in the original. Some lines are faint and damaged at the right edge; readings such as "Grandissonensi" and "Ducentum-viro" are uncertain and may need checking. The faint show-through at the foot is not transcribed.
